checks.evidence: Army.mil, dated 2026-08-26, lists the five selected Janus vendors and installations, including Antares Nuclear at Fort Bragg. Antares announced the same day that it had been awarded a Janus Program agreement (Business Wire release, snippet only; the release page returned HTTP 403). The shipped News tab already carries the 2026-08-26 Antares Fort Bragg item.

checks.review: Overruled 2026-11-20 (same reading as 2026-11-02): the Army's own 2026-08-26 release says it 'down-selected potential industry awardees for negotiation of Other Transactions Authority-based agreements'.
